confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Essaouira's tourist price level. Not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable; beer and wine prices vary by licensed venue, and accommodation is less certain given July peak demand. Cocktail and wine anchors were not known directly, so they were set from the beer anchor: cocktail about twice the beer anchor and wine glass about 1.4 times it. FX caveat: the 0.6979 value dated 2026-10-09 came from a third-party site (ozfinancehub.com.au) that attributes it to the RBA. I did not open rba.gov.au or table F11.1, so the value and date are unverified against the official source and should be checked before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Morocco's coastal tourist towns such as Agadir and Tangier, with prices set somewhat below Marrakech tourist levels. No single comparable city was used.
